summary: `bun obs person --name "<display name>"` and email lookups returned idp_users.id, the identity provider's id, while every span carries the app account id (profile.id / auth_external_accounts.user_id), so no signed-in person could ever be found by name or email: 86 of 86 provider users in production map to an app account with a different id, and the name search reported "Nothing happened" for an account that was active that evening. Name and email lookups now end in auth_external_accounts and return the app account.
